## Orientation

Single task in wave 4. Frozen oracle: dashboard/frontend/src/lib/screens/phaseLeaf.test.ts (read it first; do not edit). The oracle file effortPhaseRows.test.ts and the R30 case in e2e/app.spec.ts stay red until later tasks; npm test fails only on those. Judge your work with vitest --exclude for them. Earlier tasks added routePhase in areas.ts (phase route only), PhaseState.routeEffort/routePhase in phase.svelte.ts, and the phase page. Do not run git commit; the parent commits. Do not touch .canon or call canon. If a frozen oracle contradicts a pinned test or the Approach, stop and report the conflict as blocked; do not edit the oracle.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/phase-level--leaf-over-page`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R9: A requirement button on the phase page opens the requirement view as a modal.
R26: A leaf view opened from the phase page leaves the phase page in place behind it.
R27: Closing a leaf modal returns to the phase page URL.

## Approach

Read the frozen tests in `dashboard/frontend/src/lib/screens/phaseLeaf.test.ts` first. They mount `App` and fix the selectors.

- Extend `routePhase` in `areas.ts` to resolve `requirement` routes (`parts[1]` effort, `parts[2]` phase) and `task` routes (the `phase` of the task row found by id in the snapshot). `App.svelte` mounts `PhasePage` when `routePhase` resolves, not only when the route name is `phase`. The breadcrumb and the rail follow, because they read `routePhase`. The `needs`, `backlog` and `record` routes keep the page they have today.
- `PhaseState` keys its load on effort and phase, not on the route name. Opening or closing a modal neither refetches nor clears the page.
- `leaveHref()` in `polling.svelte.ts` returns the phase href for a `task` or `requirement` route, so a deep-linked modal closes onto its phase page.
- A requirement button or a task row opens its modal with `openHash`, so the phase URL sits on the back stack and Back, Esc and the close button return to it.
- Update any `area-levels` test that asserts the effort-level chrome on a task or requirement route.
- Close with `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R9: A requirement button on the phase page opens the requirement view as a modal.
R26: A leaf view opened from the phase page leaves the phase page in place behind it.
R27: Closing a leaf modal returns to the phase page URL.

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

- Hash routing only. One served document.
- The phase page writes nothing.
- The URL decides the selected phase.
- Existing deep links resolve.

## Assumptions

- Phase `area-levels` is merged and exports the breadcrumb and the rail.
- The existing view-model builders (`buildPhaseChrome`, `taskBoard`, `evidenceBoard`, `buildWaveGraph`, `detailView`) can be called outside a dialog.
- Task and requirement modals open from the phase route without a page reload.


- `leaf-views-stay-modals`: The task, requirement, needs, backlog and record views stay modals over the phase page
